# Agent routing benchmark

> Weekly ranking of four coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI, Grok CLI) for five task classes (coding, agentic, research, reading, writing), from public leaderboards and own job outcomes.

## Data

- [bench.md](/bench.md): compact Markdown routing table, plan usage and feed freshness; start here.
- [bench.json](/bench.json): full ranking with every scoring input, method and notes (schema_version 2).
